title: Uniform convergence of difference quotients of a C^1 map into a normed space
statement: Let n be a natural number, E a real normed space, g : R^n -> E, U an open subset of R^n, K a compact subset of R^n with K ⊆ U, and e ∈ R^n. Assume g is C^1 on U. Then the difference quotients d^{-1}(g(x + d e) - g(x)) converge to Dg(x) e (Dg = fderiv) uniformly for x ∈ K as d -> 0 with d ≠ 0, i.e. along the punctured neighbourhood filter 𝓝[≠] 0 of 0 in R.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (g : Rn n → E) (U K : Set (Rn n)) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → TendstoUniformlyOn (fun (d : ℝ) (x : Rn n) => d⁻¹ • (g (x + d • e) - g x)) (fun x => fderiv ℝ g x e) (𝓝[≠] 0) K
